author: The Infographics Show
description:
Some of the richest people in tech are spending hundreds of millions of dollars on bunkers, fortified compounds, private farmland, and self-sufficient shelters. Why?

This video explores why billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg are preparing for scenarios most people would consider unthinkable. Behind the optimism surrounding artificial intelligence are growing concerns about mass job displacement, extreme inequality, cyberattacks, autonomous AI agents, and even the possibility of systems becoming impossible to control. AI researchers themselves have warned about catastrophic risks, while some tech insiders have openly discussed building bunkers before more advanced forms of artificial intelligence arrive. At the same time, powerful AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of operating independently, exploiting vulnerabilities, and ignoring instructions in pursuit of their goals.

title: Tech billionaires are panicking...
